subject.title: feat(ios): show OpenClaw logo in notch

question: May OpenClaw ship this iOS screenshot-branding overlay using a newly tagged TopNotch fork that has no detected license and relies on private UIScreen KVC, and what provenance/license requirement must be met first?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether the legal/provenance and App Store-review tradeoff is acceptable for a distributed iOS app, especially while the dependency has no license file to bundle.

options.title: Require licensed provenance before merge
options.body: Ask for a clear TopNotch license or approved replacement, add the required iOS license acknowledgement, then re-review the private-API release risk with archive proof.

options.title: Approve the risk explicitly
options.body: iOS/release owners can accept the current private-API and dependency-provenance risk as an intentional release tradeoff after recording archive proof.

options.title: Defer the notch overlay
options.body: Close or pause this cosmetic feature if screenshot branding is not worth the dependency, license, and App Store-review cost.

recommendation.title: Require licensed provenance before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for a clear TopNotch license or approved replacement, add the required iOS license acknowledgement, then re-review the private-API release risk with archive proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS release, App Store/versioning, Watch target, and project.yml work make this the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the release-risk decision.
